<js>
var javaImport = new JavaImporter();
javaImport.importPackage(
     Packages.java.lang,
    Packages.javax.crypto.spec,
    Packages.javax.crypto,
    Packages.java.util 
);
with(javaImport){
    let IV_PARAMETER = String("1ae2c94b");
    let ALGORITHM = "DES"; 
    let CIPHER_ALGORITHM = "DES/CBC/PKCS5Padding";
    let CHARSET = "utf-8";
    let password=String("KK!%G3JdCHJxpAF3%Vg9pN");


function decode(data){
let dks = new DESKeySpec(String(password).getBytes());
let keyFactory = SecretKeyFactory.getInstance("DES");
let secretKey = keyFactory.generateSecret(dks);
let cipher = Cipher.getInstance(CIPHER_ALGORITHM);
let iv = new IvParameterSpec(IV_PARAMETER.getBytes(CHARSET));
cipher.init(Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE, secretKey, iv);
return new String(cipher.doFinal(Base64.getDecoder().decode(String(data).getBytes(CHARSET))), CHARSET);

}
}
//DES解密结束

}

url = ""

  lastchapter: lastchapter,

ruleBookInfo.init:
<js>
name = java.getString("h4@text")


author = java.getString("class.detail_imform_value.0@text") 


kind = java.getString("class.detail_imform_value.-1@text").replace("\/",",")


lastchapter = "" 


i = java.getString("class.detail_imform_desc_pre@html")


v = book.getVariable("custom") !="" ? book.getVariable("custom") : "0"


v = parseInt(v)


t = java.getStringList("#menu0@li@text")


Urls = java.getElements("#main0@div@ul"); 


if(v >= t.length || v < 0) { v = Math.floor(Math.random() * t.length); }


urls = Urls[v].select('li')


java.put("list", urls)


n = ""


for (o = 0; o < t.length; o++) {
  
  urls = Urls[o].select('li')

  f = "❤序号🔺" + o + "🔻【" + t[o] + "】 \n路线：" + t[o] + " \n最新章节：第" + urls.length + "集\n"
  n += f
}


usage = "\n📌使用说明： 根据序号设置书籍变量来切换来源(默认0)，若填写数字超出接口范围，会随机调用\n"


currentSource = "🎯当前源：序号🔺" + v + "🔻【" + t[v] + "】 (默认)\n"


intro = i + "\n" + usage + currentSource + n


cover = java.getString("class.blockcontent.0@img@src")

url = ""


JSON.stringify({
  name: name,
  author: author,
  kind: kind,
  lastchapter: lastchapter,
  intro: intro,
  cover: cover,
  url: url
})

</js>

source.bookSourceComment:
感谢 @柚屿.  提供方法
by天天的鸟蛋蛋 修改简介
提供的原方法
<js>
name = java.getString("h1@text")
author = java.getString("class.module-info-item-content.0@a@text") 
kind = java.getString("class.module-info-tag@text").replace("\/",",") 
lastchapter = java.getString("class.module-info-item-content.3@text").replace("更新至","") 
i = java.getString("class.module-info-introduction-content@text").replace("　　","　　简介：")
t = java.getStringList("#y-playList@span@text")
r = java.getStringList("#y-playList@small@text")
v = book.getVariable("custom") !="" ? book.getVariable("custom") : "0"
if(v > t.length || v < 0) { v = Math.floor(Math.random() * n.length); }
java.put("v",v)
n = "接口: "
for (o = 0; o < t.length; o++) {
  f = t[o] + "(共 " + r[o] + " 集)" + "，"
  n += f
}
intro = i + "\n" + n + "\n注:填写书籍变量，刷新详情页切换正文接口,默认接口为0，若填写数字超出接口范围，会随机调用。\n当前接口: " + t[v] + "  共 "+r[v]+" 集"
cover = java.getString("class.module-item-pic.0@img@data-original") 
url = ""
JSON.stringify({
  name: name,
  author: author,
  kind: kind,
  lastchapter: lastchapter,
  intro: intro,
  cover: cover,
  url: url
})
</js>

book.intro: （《斗灵大陆》又名《从九尾狐开始召唤进化》）”一觉醒来，胡栎穿越斗灵大陆。更没想到，自己竟然变成了一只狐狸！斗灵世界是一个充满兽灵的世界，修士收服灵兽做为兽灵，而胡栎以将魂做兽灵，独步天下！“叮！获得召唤进化系统！”一重天：进化为九尾妖狐……“叮！召唤西楚霸王项羽！”“叮！召唤如意金箍棒！”“叮！召唤洛神甄姬！”……从此以后，斗灵大陆出现来一个妖孽，以兽之身召唤强大的人魂为其战斗。胡栎：“你有兽灵，我有名将千千万！”

book.name: 斗灵大陆

ruleContent.content:
<js>
var out = '';
try {
    // 抛弃正则，直接用字符串分割，完美避开嵌套大括号被截断的问题
    var parts = String(result).split('var player_aaaa=');
    if (parts.length > 1) {
        // 截取到 </script> 之前的内容
        var jsonStr = parts[1].split('</script>')[0].trim();
        // 如果末尾有分号，则去掉分号，确保是纯净的 JSON
        if (jsonStr.charAt(jsonStr.length - 1) === ';') {
            jsonStr = jsonStr.slice(0, -1);
        }
        
        var data = JSON.parse(jsonStr);
        var url = String(data.url);
        
        if (data.encrypt == 2) {
            var b64Str = String(java.base64Decode(url));
            url = decodeURIComponent(b64Str);
        } else if (data.encrypt == 1) {
            url = decodeURIComponent(url);
        }
        
        out = '' + url.replace(/\\\//g, '/');
    } else {
        out = '⚠️ 解析失败，源码中未找到 player_aaaa 配置。';
    }
} catch(e) {
    out = '⚠️ 解析异常：' + String(e);
}
out;
</js>

try {
    // 抛弃正则，直接用字符串分割，完美避开嵌套大括号被截断的问题
    var parts = String(result).split('var player_aaaa=');
    if (parts.length > 1) {
        // 截取到 </script> 之前的内容
        var jsonStr = parts[1].split('</script>')[0].trim();
        // 如果末尾有分号，则去掉分号，确保是纯净的 JSON
        if (jsonStr.charAt(jsonStr.length - 1) === ';') {
            jsonStr = jsonStr.slice(0, -1);
        }
        
        var data = JSON.parse(jsonStr);
        var url = String(data.url);
        
        if (data.encrypt == 2) {
            var b64Str = String(java.base64Decode(url));
            url = decodeURIComponent(b64Str);
        } else if (data.encrypt == 1) {
            url = decodeURIComponent(url);
        }
        
        out = '' + url.replace(/\\\//g, '/');
    } else {
        out = '⚠️ 解析失败，源码中未找到 player_aaaa 配置。';
    }
} catch(e) {
    out = '⚠️ 解析异常：' + String(e);
}
out;

book.author: 罗贯中
book.intro: 《中国古典文学名著普及本：三国演义（超值金版）》是我国小说史上最著名最杰出的长篇章回体历史小说。小说艺术地再现了始于黄巾起义，终于西晋统一近百年的历史风云画卷。作者通过集中描写三国时代各统治集团之间的政治、军事、外交斗争，揭示了东汉末年社会的动荡与黑暗，反映了人民的苦难，表达了人民呼唤明君、要求安定的强烈愿望。
book.name: 三国演义
